name: repolore
description: Search your own pull requests, reviews, issues, commits and repo docs on GitHub. Needs repolore-mcp 0.3.0 or later: uv tool install --managed-python --python 3.12 repolore-mcp, then repolore setup.

refresh_hours.title: Refresh interval (hours)
refresh_hours.description: Start a background refresh when a session starts and the last refresh is at least this many hours old; 0 turns it off.
